profile.headline: Software Engineer at Giv.
profile.summary: A senior engineer with 11+ years of background leading, architecting, building and maintaining software systems to push businesses forward. Experienced in end-to-end project management, bringing concepts to reality with real monetary value. Consistently recognized as one who gets things done, with creative solutions and always with the business interest in mind.

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
positions.description: Skills: Team Management · Postgres · Amazon SQS · Angular · JavaScript · Terraform · Python (Programming Language) · Git · Node.js

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Used frontend frameworks to assist the team with revamping the UI in order to land a multimillion dollar contract.
● Added new API endpoints in for meeting compliance requirements for said contract.
● Altered automation deployments, which improved security with missing HTTP headers.
● Worked with and mentored new developers, guiding them through codebases and AWS infrastructure.
● Assisted the analytics team with creating metrics for a critical backend service.
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · Go (Programming Language) · Angular · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Golang · Terraform · Git

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer / Co-Founder
positions.description:
● Architected and developed admin platforms to manage both data and clients providing a clearer business insight.
● Designed and built two client facing SaaS products for skip-tracing and data-feed subscriptions, which soon became industry leading in performance and customer usability.
● Designed and implemented custom data pipelines for consuming, scrubbing, filtering and storing data resulting in better data quality.
● Managed local and distributed developers with excellent communication which improved company productivity and faster data delivery times.
● Integrated third-party services such as Twilio (SMS), Stripe (Payments) and Sendgrid (Email) into our platforms for a better customer experience.
● Linux server stand-up and management using DigitalOcean keeping costs low and 100% up-time.
positions.insights: Skills: VueJS · Team Management · Postgres · ArangoDB · Go (Programming Language) · JavaScript · Golang · Project Management · Git

positions.title: Backend Engineer
positions.description:
● Bringing my expertise with Golang to the engineering team in order to improve the overall systems.
● Coordinated with the principle engineer on design patterns, resulting in higher quality and easier to read code.
● Worked in tandem with the crypto team to help get MVP to market more quickly.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
●	Worked directly with the CEO and President to bring concepts to reality, and managed those projects end-to-end.
●	Improved business intelligence systems, helping the company achieve an industry-leading occupancy rate in the high 90s to 100%!
●	Designed and developed multiple mobile apps for executives to manage their business and improve productivity.
●	Researched new technologies to keep the company up-to-date and competitive.
positions.insights: Skills: VueJS · PHP · JavaScript · Perl · MySQL · Project Management · Git
